name: Laurent Mazaré
bio: Laurent Mazaré is a co-founder of Kyutai, where Mazaré leads engineering, and a co-founder of the voice AI company Gradium. Mazaré is a listed author of the Moshi technical report and is known for open-source machine learning libraries in Rust, including the Candle framework used in Moshi's Rust implementation.
known_for: Co-author of the Moshi technical report
Rust machine learning libraries including Candle
